The Master answered him in terms of the Three Virtues (of straightness, decisiveness, and flexible victoriousness, as proper guidance for culinary matters) in the Wine Announcement and the Hóngfàn in the Documents .” 【1. The Master's response is rude and very informally witty. We can call it urbane. 2. This precious piece shows how WT imposed on his students a hyperpedantic philosophical spirit according to which everything was to be measured by its treatment in the classics. 3. Note that it is still far from certain that his absurd pedantic classicism was to the taste of the editors of ZS. After all, they must have been familiar with 世說新語 which castigates and ridicules such extremist classicism. There is a possibility this passage represents a "realist" imitation of the so-called "Daoist" elements that are so prominent as features in the Analects. 4. I suspect, in fact, an influence from 世說新語 on this piece.】
